lifecycle_identity: Document buffers are store-owned and persist independently of the current view badge.

obligations.text: When edit(text) is invoked while a document view is active, submit the text to that document's existing trailing task rather than writing to the store immediately.
For each editing burst, wait for a 120 ms interval with no newer edit for that document, then perform exactly one store write containing the latest text in that burst.
A newer edit before the quiet interval ends must cancel and replace the prior scheduled save so superseded text is not written.
After a burst is saved, the same document buffer must accept later edits and save each subsequent burst under the same 120 ms trailing semantics.
Pending document saves must persist independently of view close, navigation, disposal, and live badge-subscription retirement because document buffers are owned by the store BufferBank.
Preserve synchronous reentrant navigation semantics: store listeners may navigate during a save, and a newer navigation request must remain authoritative over an older operation's continuation.

Preserve all other editor behavior and public interfaces, including open, edit, close, dispose, document rendering, status subscription behavior, document identity, text, and status payload semantics.

class BufferBank {constructor(){this.entries=new Map();}get(env,id){if(!this.entries.has(id))this.entries.set(id,trailing(env.timers,120,text=>env.store.write(id,text)));return this.entries.get(id);}}
if(!env.store.documentBuffers)env.store.documentBuffers=new BufferBank();const bank=env.store.documentBuffers;

open(id){const mine=++request;retire();if(true&&mine!==request)return;const buffer=bank.get(env,id),stop=env.store.subscribe(event=>{if(event.id===id)env.renderStatus(event);});setView({id,buffer,stop});env.renderDocument({id,text:env.store.read(id)});},edit(text){const view=getView();if(view){env.store.write(view.id,text);}}
push(text) { if (ticket !== null) timers.cancel(ticket); value = text; ticket = timers.schedule(flush, wait); }
const flush = () => { const saved = value; retire(); if (saved !== null) consume(saved); };

return{open:id=>node.triggerHandler('draft:open.scope',[id]),edit:t=>node.triggerHandler('draft:edit.scope',[t]),close:()=>node.triggerHandler('draft:close.scope'),dispose(){api.dispose();node.off('.scope');node.removeData('view');}};
